study type: Observational study emulating a sequence of target trials
exposure: antibiotic initiation between 24 and 37 weeks gestation
cohort: The study included 111,403 individuals presenting to care before 24 weeks gestation in Botswana between 2014 and 2021, drawn from the Tsepamo Study.
finding: Emulating a sequence of target trials showed a pooled adjusted risk ratio of 1.11 (95% CI: 1.06, 1.15) for preterm delivery with antibiotic initiation between 24 and 37 weeks, highlighting that analyses susceptible to immortal time bias can falsely make antibiotics appear protective against preterm delivery.
gest_age: Exposure window: 24 to 37 weeks; Cohort eligibility: <24 weeks
